entries.title: II Timothy 2:1
segments: ¶Thou therefore, my child, be strong in the grace which [is] in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:2
segments: And the things thou hast heard of me in the presence of many witnesses, these entrust to faithful men, such as shall be competent to instruct others also.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:3
segments: Take thy share in suffering as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:4
segments: No one going as a soldier entangles himself with the affairs of life, that he may please him who has enlisted him as a soldier.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:5
segments: And if also any one contend [in the games], he is not crowned unless he contend lawfully.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:6
segments: The husbandman must labour before partaking of the fruits.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:7
segments: Think of what I say, for the Lord will give thee understanding in all things.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:8
segments: ¶Remember Jesus Christ raised from among [the] dead, of [the] seed of David, according to my glad tidings,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:9
segments: in which I suffer even unto bonds as an evil-doer: but the word of God is not bound.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:10
segments: For this cause I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that *they* also may obtain the salvation which [is] in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:11
segments: The word [is] faithful; for if we have died together with [him], we shall also live together;

entries.title: II Timothy 2:12
segments: if we endure, we shall also reign together; if we deny, *he* also will deny us;

entries.title: II Timothy 2:13
segments: if we are unfaithful, *he* abides faithful, for he cannot deny himself.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:14
segments: ¶Of these things put in remembrance, testifying earnestly before the Lord not to have disputes of words, profitable for nothing, to the subversion of the hearers.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:15
segments: Strive diligently to present thyself approved to God, a workman that has not to be ashamed, cutting in a straight line the word of truth.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:16
segments: But profane, vain babblings shun, for they will advance to greater impiety,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:17
segments: and their word will spread as a gangrene; of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

entries.title: II Timothy 2:18
segments: [men] who as to the truth have gone astray, saying that the resurrection has taken place already; and overthrow the faith of some.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:19
segments: ¶Yet the firm foundation of God stands, having this seal, [The] Lord knows those that are his; and, Let every one who names the name of [the] Lord withdraw from iniquity.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:20
segments: But in a great house there are not only gold and silver vessels, but also wooden and earthen; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:21
segments: If therefore one shall have purified himself from these, [in separating himself from them], he shall be a vessel to honour, sanctified, serviceable to the Master, prepared for every good work.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:22
segments: ¶But youthful lusts flee, and pursue righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those that call upon the Lord out of a pure heart.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:23
segments: But foolish and senseless questionings avoid, knowing that they beget contentions.

entries.title: II Timothy 2:24
segments: And a bondman of [the] Lord ought not to contend, but be gentle towards all; apt to teach; forbearing;

entries.title: II Timothy 2:25
segments: in meekness setting right those who oppose, if God perhaps may sometime give them repentance to acknowledgment of [the] truth,

entries.title: II Timothy 2:26
segments: and that they may awake up out of the snare of the devil, [who are] taken by him, for *his* will.
